insights.title: 62′ · Shape change
insights.text: A switch to 4–3–3 added width on the right.

missing_information: Final score, tracking data and the complete substitution list are not available in this sample.

example.question: Did the substitution improve our attack, or did we just have more possession?
example.answer:
**It changed where Sport could attack.**

At 62 minutes, Lucas Silva replaced André Costa. The fictional sample report describes a move to 4–3–3, with Lucas staying wide on the right. [1]

**What the evidence suggests**

- Right-sided box entries rose from 1 to 3 across the observed periods. [1]
- Sport had 61% possession, but the xG gap was only 0.15. [2]

**Interpretation:** the change may have improved access on the right. These figures alone cannot prove the substitution caused it.
